scripts.config:check: bun run scripts/bun-toolchain-check.ts && bun run src/config-check.ts
scripts.config:inspect: bun run scripts/bun-toolchain-check.ts && bun run src/config-check.ts inspect
scripts.di:generate: bun run scripts/bun-toolchain-check.ts && bun run src/osnova/core/scripts/di-generate.ts
scripts.predev: bun run scripts/bun-toolchain-check.ts && bun run di:generate
scripts.dev: bun run scripts/bun-toolchain-check.ts && OSNV_ENV=development bun run src/index.ts
scripts.prestart: bun run scripts/bun-toolchain-check.ts && bun run di:generate
scripts.start: bun run scripts/bun-toolchain-check.ts && OSNV_ENV=production bun run src/index.ts
scripts.build: bun run scripts/bun-toolchain-check.ts && bun x tsc --noEmit
scripts.admin:backend: bun run scripts/bun-toolchain-check.ts && OSNV_ENV=development bun run src/admin-ui-dev.ts
scripts.pretest: bun run scripts/bun-toolchain-check.ts && bun run di:generate --target all
scripts.build:bin: bun run scripts/bun-toolchain-check.ts && bun run build:bin:app && bun run build:bin:cli
scripts.build:bin:app: bun run scripts/bun-toolchain-check.ts && bun run scripts/build-bin.ts src/index.ts bin/osnova-app
scripts.build:bin:cli: bun run scripts/bun-toolchain-check.ts && bun run scripts/build-bin.ts src/osnova/cli/main.ts bin/osnv
